## Step 1.5: Diagnose Current Results and Assess Model Fit

```{r diagnose-results}
cat("=== DIAGNOSING MONTE CARLO RESULTS ===\n")

# Check structure of results
if(length(monte_carlo_results$parameters) > 0) {
  cat("Parameters structure - first result fields:\n")
  cat(paste(names(monte_carlo_results$parameters[[1]]), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  
  cat("Monte Carlo Results Summary:\n")
  cat("  Total simulations attempted:", monte_carlo_results$n_attempts, "\n")
  cat("  Successful simulations:", monte_carlo_results$n_successful, "\n")
  cat("  Success rate:", round(monte_carlo_results$n_successful/monte_carlo_results$n_attempts*100, 1), "%\n")
  cat("  Failed simulations:", length(monte_carlo_results$failed), "\n\n")
  
  # Check gamma parameter variability
  if("gamma_change" %in% names(monte_carlo_results$parameters[[1]])) {
    all_gamma_changes <- unlist(lapply(monte_carlo_results$parameters, function(x) x$gamma_change))
    cat("Gamma parameter analysis:\n")
    cat("  Range:", round(min(all_gamma_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "to", round(max(all_gamma_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
    cat("  Mean:", round(mean(all_gamma_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "± SD:", round(sd(all_gamma_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
  cat("  Example values:", paste(round(all_gamma_changes[seq_len(min(10, length(all_gamma_changes)))], 3), collapse=", "), "\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("WARNING: gamma_change not found in parameters!\n\n")
  }
  
  # Check catchability parameter variability
  if("catchability_change" %in% names(monte_carlo_results$parameters[[1]])) {
    all_catch_changes <- unlist(lapply(monte_carlo_results$parameters, function(x) {
      if(length(x$catchability_change) > 0) x$catchability_change else NA
    }))
    all_catch_changes <- all_catch_changes[!is.na(all_catch_changes)]
    
    if(length(all_catch_changes) > 0) {
      cat("Catchability parameter analysis:\n")
      cat("  Range:", round(min(all_catch_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "to", round(max(all_catch_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("  Mean:", round(mean(all_catch_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "± SD:", round(sd(all_catch_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n\n")
    } else {
      cat("No catchability variations found\n\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Check abundance scaling variability
  if("abundance_scaling" %in% names(monte_carlo_results$parameters[[1]])) {
    all_abund_changes <- unlist(lapply(monte_carlo_results$parameters, function(x) x$abundance_scaling))
    cat("Abundance scaling analysis:\n")
    cat("  Range:", round(min(all_abund_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "to", round(max(all_abund_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
    cat("  Mean:", round(mean(all_abund_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "± SD:", round(sd(all_abund_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n\n")
  }
  
  # Check if simulations are valid mizer objects
  sims_valid <- sum(sapply(monte_carlo_results$simulations, function(x) {
    !is.null(x) && inherits(x, "MizerSim")
  }))
  cat("Valid mizer simulation objects:", sims_valid, "\n")
  
  # Basic model fit assessment using yield data
  if(sims_valid > 0 && exists("yield_ts_tidy")) {
    cat("\n=== MODEL FIT ASSESSMENT ===\n")
    
    # Calculate fit metrics for available simulations
    fit_metrics <- data.frame()
    
    for(i in seq_along(monte_carlo_results$simulations)) {
      sim <- monte_carlo_results$simulations[[i]]
      if(!is.null(sim) && inherits(sim, "MizerSim")) {
        
        tryCatch({
          # Extract modeled yields using mizer functions
          yield_matrix <- getYield(sim)
          yield_df <- reshape2::melt(yield_matrix)
          names(yield_df) <- c("Year", "Species", "Yield")
          
          # Filter for comparison period across the full observed range
          obs_years <- range(yield_ts_tidy$Year, na.rm = TRUE)
          model_yield_period <- yield_df %>%
            filter(Year >= obs_years[1], Year <= obs_years[2])
          
          if(nrow(model_yield_period) > 0) {
            # Calculate total yield over period
            model_total <- sum(model_yield_period$Yield, na.rm=TRUE)
            
            # Compare with observed data if available
            if(exists("yield_ts_tidy") && !is.null(yield_ts_tidy)) {
              obs_period <- yield_ts_tidy
              
              if(nrow(obs_period) > 0) {
                obs_total <- sum(obs_period$Yield, na.rm=TRUE)
                
                # Calculate annual correlation if possible
                annual_comparison <- model_yield_period %>%
                  group_by(Year) %>%
                  summarise(model_yield = sum(Yield, na.rm=TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
                  left_join(obs_period %>% 
                           group_by(Year) %>%
                           summarise(obs_yield = sum(Yield, na.rm=TRUE), .groups = 'drop'),
                           by = "Year") %>%
                  filter(!is.na(obs_yield), !is.na(model_yield))
                
                if(nrow(annual_comparison) > 5) {
                  correlation <- cor(annual_comparison$model_yield, annual_comparison$obs_yield, use="complete.obs")
                  rmse <- sqrt(mean((annual_comparison$model_yield - annual_comparison$obs_yield)^2, na.rm=TRUE))
                  normalized_rmse <- rmse / mean(annual_comparison$obs_yield, na.rm=TRUE)
                  
                  fit_metrics <- rbind(fit_metrics, data.frame(
                    sim_id = i,
                    correlation = correlation,
                    rmse = rmse,
                    normalized_rmse = normalized_rmse,
                    model_total = model_total,
                    observed_total = obs_total
                  ))
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }, error = function(e) {
          # Skip simulations that can't be processed
          cat("  Simulation", i, "failed yield extraction:", e$message, "\n")
        })
      }
    }
    
    if(nrow(fit_metrics) > 0) {
      cat("Model fit summary (", nrow(fit_metrics), " simulations):\n")
      cat("  Correlation range:", round(min(fit_metrics$correlation, na.rm=TRUE), 3), 
          "to", round(max(fit_metrics$correlation, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("  Mean correlation:", round(mean(fit_metrics$correlation, na.rm=TRUE), 3), 
          "± SD:", round(sd(fit_metrics$correlation, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("  Normalized RMSE range:", round(min(fit_metrics$normalized_rmse, na.rm=TRUE), 3), 
          "to", round(max(fit_metrics$normalized_rmse, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("  Mean normalized RMSE:", round(mean(fit_metrics$normalized_rmse, na.rm=TRUE), 3), 
          "± SD:", round(sd(fit_metrics$normalized_rmse, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n\n")
      
      # Show best fitting simulations
      best_sims <- fit_metrics[order(-fit_metrics$correlation, fit_metrics$normalized_rmse), ]
      cat("Top 3 fitting simulations:\n")
  for(j in seq_len(min(3, nrow(best_sims)))) {
        cat("  Sim", best_sims$sim_id[j], ": r =", round(best_sims$correlation[j], 3), 
            ", NRMSE =", round(best_sims$normalized_rmse[j], 3), "\n")
      }
      
    } else {
      cat("No valid yield comparisons with observed data available\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("No valid simulations available for model fit assessment\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No parameter combinations found!\n")
}

# Parameter space refinement suggestions
cat("\n=== PARAMETER SPACE REFINEMENT SUGGESTIONS ===\n")

if(exists("fit_metrics") && nrow(fit_metrics) > 0) {
  # Analyze parameter combinations of best-performing simulations
  cat("Based on model fit analysis:\n")
  
  best_sim_ids <- {
    ord <- order(-fit_metrics$correlation, fit_metrics$normalized_rmse)
    fit_metrics$sim_id[ord][seq_len(min(3, length(ord)))]
  }
  
  for(param_type in c("gamma_change", "catchability_change", "abundance_scaling")) {
    if(param_type %in% names(monte_carlo_results$parameters[[1]])) {

        params <- monte_carlo_results$parameters[[id]]
        if(param_type %in% names(params) && length(params[[param_type]]) > 0) {

        } else {
          NA
        }
      })
      
      if(any(!is.na(best_values))) {
        cat("  Best", gsub("_change|_scaling", "", param_type), "factors:", 
            paste(round(best_values[!is.na(best_values)], 3), collapse=", "), "\n")
        cat("    -> Suggests focusing search around", 
            round(mean(best_values, na.rm=TRUE), 2), "± ", 
            round(sd(best_values, na.rm=TRUE), 2), "\n")
      }
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("Insufficient data for parameter refinement suggestions.\n")
  cat("Recommendations:\n")

## Step 2: Assess Parameter Distributions (Pre-Rejection)

Before applying any rejection criteria, let's examine the distributions of the parameters we varied.

```{r assess-parameter-distributions}
cat("=== PARAMETER DISTRIBUTION ASSESSMENT ===\n")

# Improved gamma plotter: bin in log10 space with readable ticks and robust limits
plot_gamma_distribution_fixed <- function(param_combinations, title_suffix = "") {
  require(ggplot2)
  require(dplyr)
  require(scales)

  gamma_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(param_combinations), function(i) {
    params <- param_combinations[[i]]
    if (is.null(params)) return(NULL)
    # Prefer the raw multiplier (pre-clamp) if present; fallback to effective change vs original
    val <- if (!is.null(params$gamma_change_raw)) params$gamma_change_raw else params$gamma_change
    if (is.null(val)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(
      sim_id = i,
      species = params$species_names,
      gamma_change = val
    )
  }))

  if (is.null(gamma_data) || nrow(gamma_data) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + labs(title = paste("Gamma Parameter Distribution", title_suffix), subtitle = "No data"))
  }

  # Keep finite, positive values and switch to log10 for proper histogram binning
  gamma_data <- gamma_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$gamma_change), .data$gamma_change > 0) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(log10_gamma = log10(.data$gamma_change))

  if (nrow(gamma_data) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + labs(title = paste("Gamma Parameter Distribution", title_suffix), subtitle = "No positive finite values"))
  }

  # Robust limits: trim extreme tails to focus on the mass
  rng <- quantile(gamma_data$log10_gamma, c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(rng[1]) || !is.finite(rng[2]) || rng[1] == rng[2]) {
    rng <- range(gamma_data$log10_gamma, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  pad <- max(0.05, (rng[2] - rng[1]) * 0.05)
  xmin <- floor(rng[1] - pad)
  xmax <- ceiling(rng[2] + pad)

  # Binwidth ~ 0.1 decade (adjust to spread bins sensibly)
  bw <- max(0.05, (xmax - xmin) / 60)
  breaks <- seq(floor(xmin), ceiling(xmax))

  ggplot(gamma_data, aes(x = log10_gamma)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = bw, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~species, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = breaks,
      labels = function(x) scales::math_format(10^.x)(x)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(xmin, xmax)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Gamma Parameter Distribution", title_suffix),
      x = "Gamma Change Factor (log10 scale)",
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.8)
}

# Build priors from a previous Monte Carlo results RDS
compute_priors_from_results <- function(rds_path,
                                        accepted_only = TRUE,
                                        species_reference) {
  res <- readRDS(rds_path)
  # Detect parameter list
  param_list <- NULL
  if (!is.null(res$accepted_parameters) && accepted_only) {
    param_list <- res$accepted_parameters
  } else if (!is.null(res$parameters)) {
    param_list <- res$parameters
  } else {
    stop("Could not find parameter combinations in provided RDS")
  }

  # Extract per-sim parameter changes
  df_list <- lapply(param_list, function(x) {
    if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
    sp <- x$species_names
    # Prefer raw multiplier when available
    gamma_mult <- if (!is.null(x$gamma_change_raw)) x$gamma_change_raw else x$gamma_change
    abund_mult <- x$abundance_scaling
    if (is.null(sp) || is.null(gamma_mult) || is.null(abund_mult)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(species = sp, gamma_mult = gamma_mult, abundance_mult = abund_mult)
  })
  df <- do.call(rbind, df_list)
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) stop("No usable parameter data in prior RDS")

  # Aggregate to medians per species
  med <- df %>% dplyr::group_by(species) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      gamma_prior = median(gamma_mult, na.rm = TRUE),
      abundance_prior = median(abundance_mult, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )

  # Align to reference species order; default 1 if missing
  ref <- species_reference
  gpr <- setNames(rep(1, length(ref)), ref)
  apr <- setNames(rep(1, length(ref)), ref)
  common <- intersect(ref, med$species)
  if (length(common) > 0) {
    msub <- med[match(common, med$species), ]
    gpr[common] <- msub$gamma_prior
    apr[common] <- msub$abundance_prior
  }
  list(gamma_prior = gpr, abundance_prior = apr)
}

## Step 3: Apply Biomass-Based Rejection Criteria

Now we apply the strict rejection criteria: remove any parameter sets where the modeled biomass 
(averaged over 2000-2010) falls outside ±25% of the observed biomass (2010-2020) for ANY species.

```{r define-relaxed-rejection, echo=FALSE}
# Relaxed biomass rejection criteria allowing up to N species outside bounds
apply_biomass_rejection_criteria <- function(sim_results, param_combinations,
                                             obs_biomass_data,
                                             tolerance = 0.25,
                                             comparison_years = 2000:2010,
                                             verbose = TRUE,
                                             allow_outside = 3,
                                             obs_bounds_table = NULL) {
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Applying biomass rejection criteria ... (allow up to", allow_outside, "species outside bounds)\n")
  }

  # Determine observed bounds per species
  if (!is.null(obs_bounds_table)) {
    # Use provided species-specific bounds (in grams)
    obs_bounds <- obs_bounds_table %>%
      dplyr::transmute(Species, lower_bound = Lower_g, upper_bound = Upper_g)
  } else if (exists("obs_biomass_bounds")) {
    # Use globally defined species-specific bounds (in grams)
    obs_bounds <- obs_biomass_bounds %>%
      dplyr::transmute(Species, lower_bound = Lower_g, upper_bound = Upper_g)
  } else {
    # Fall back to tolerance around observed means over overlapping years
    obs_years <- intersect(unique(obs_biomass_data$Year), comparison_years)
    if (length(obs_years) == 0) {
      # Fallback: use all available years in obs if no overlap
      obs_years <- unique(obs_biomass_data$Year)
      if (verbose) cat("Warning: No overlap between obs years and comparison_years; using all observed years\n")
    }

    obs_bounds <- obs_biomass_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(Year %in% obs_years) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Species) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(obs_mean = mean(ObsBiomass, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(lower_bound = obs_mean * (1 - tolerance),
                    upper_bound = obs_mean * (1 + tolerance)) %>%
      dplyr::select(Species, lower_bound, upper_bound)
  }

  # Fast lookup vectors
  lower_by_species <- stats::setNames(obs_bounds$lower_bound, obs_bounds$Species)
  upper_by_species <- stats::setNames(obs_bounds$upper_bound, obs_bounds$Species)

  accepted_idx <- integer(0)
  details <- vector("list", length(sim_results))

  for (i in seq_along(sim_results)) {
    sim <- sim_results[[i]]
    if (is.null(sim) || !inherits(sim, "MizerSim")) next
    bm <- getBiomass(sim)
    yrs <- as.numeric(rownames(bm))
    sel <- yrs %in% comparison_years
    if (!any(sel)) next
    mean_bm <- colMeans(bm[sel, , drop = FALSE])
    species <- names(mean_bm)

    within <- vapply(species, function(sp) {
      if (sp %in% names(lower_by_species)) {
        mb <- mean_bm[[sp]]
        lower <- lower_by_species[[sp]]
        upper <- upper_by_species[[sp]]
        is.finite(mb) && is.finite(lower) && is.finite(upper) && (mb >= lower) && (mb <= upper)
      } else {
        TRUE
      }
    }, logical(1))

    species_with_obs <- species[species %in% names(lower_by_species)]
    failures <- sum(!within[names(within) %in% species_with_obs], na.rm = TRUE)
    ok <- failures <= allow_outside
    if (ok) accepted_idx <- c(accepted_idx, i)
    details[[i]] <- list(accepted = ok, species_within = within, n_failures = failures)
  }

  accepted_results <- sim_results[accepted_idx]
  accepted_parameters <- param_combinations[accepted_idx]

  if (verbose) {
    total <- length(sim_results)
    n_acc <- length(accepted_idx)
    rate <- if (total > 0) 100 * n_acc / total else 0
    cat(sprintf("Accepted %d/%d simulations (%.1f%%)\n", n_acc, total, rate))
    # Optional: quick breakdown of common failures (top 5 species by failure count)
    if (length(details) > 0) {
      # Collect species failure counts across sims with obs
      fail_counts <- list()
      for (d in details) {
        if (!is.null(d) && !is.null(d$species_within)) {
          spw <- d$species_within
          # keep names where within==FALSE
          if (!is.null(names(spw))) {
            bad <- names(spw)[!spw]
            if (length(bad) > 0) {
              for (b in bad) fail_counts[[b]] <- (fail_counts[[b]] %||% 0) + 1
            }
          }
        }
      }
      if (length(fail_counts) > 0) {
        fc <- sort(unlist(fail_counts), decreasing = TRUE)
        top <- head(fc, 5)
        cat("Top species failing bounds:",
            paste(sprintf("%s (%d)", names(top), top), collapse = ", "), "\n")
      }
    }
  }

  list(
    accepted_indices = accepted_idx,
    accepted_results = accepted_results,
    accepted_simulations = accepted_results,      # alias for compatibility
    accepted_params = accepted_parameters,
    accepted_parameters = accepted_parameters,    # alias for compatibility
    rejection_details = details,
    n_accepted = length(accepted_idx),
    acceptance_rate = length(accepted_idx) / max(1, length(sim_results))
  )
}

# Default allowance for this analysis (can be tuned)
allowed_biomass_failures <- 3
```

```{r}

rejection_results <- apply_biomass_rejection_criteria(
  monte_carlo_results$simulations,
  monte_carlo_results$parameters,
  obs_biomass_ts,
  tolerance = 0.5, 
  comparison_years = 2000:2010,
  verbose = TRUE,
  allow_outside = allowed_biomass_failures,
  obs_bounds_table = obs_biomass_bounds
)

rejection_results$n_accepted

## Step 4.5: Monte Carlo Model Assessment (Accepted Simulations)

Let's recreate the baseline assessment plots but using the accepted Monte Carlo simulations with uncertainty ribbons to show the range of plausible model outcomes.

```{r monte-carlo-model-assessment}
cat("=== STARTING MONTE CARLO MODEL ASSESSMENT ===\n")
cat("Checking if we have accepted simulations...\n")
cat("rejection_results$n_accepted:", ifelse(exists("rejection_results"), rejection_results$n_accepted, "rejection_results does not exist"), "\n")

if (rejection_results$n_accepted > 0) {
  cat("=== MONTE CARLO MODEL ASSESSMENT (ACCEPTED SIMULATIONS) ===\n")
  cat("Creating uncertainty plots with", rejection_results$n_accepted, "accepted simulations\n")
  
  # Function to extract and combine biomass data from multiple simulations
  extract_monte_carlo_biomass <- function(sim_list, sim_names = NULL) {
    cat("Extracting biomass from", length(sim_list), "simulations...\n")
    
    if (is.null(sim_names)) {
      sim_names <- paste0("MC_", seq_along(sim_list))
    }
    
    biomass_list <- lapply(seq_along(sim_list), function(i) {
      sim <- sim_list[[i]]
      cat("Processing simulation", i, "- Class:", class(sim), "\n")
      
      if (!is.null(sim) && inherits(sim, "MizerSim")) {
        tryCatch({
          biomass_matrix <- getBiomass(sim)
          cat("  Biomass matrix dimensions:", dim(biomass_matrix), "\n")
          
          biomass_df <- reshape2::melt(biomass_matrix)
          names(biomass_df) <- c("Year", "Species", "Biomass")
          biomass_df$Simulation <- sim_names[i]
          
          cat("  Extracted biomass data rows:", nrow(biomass_df), "\n")
          return(biomass_df)
        }, error = function(e) {
          cat("  Error extracting biomass from simulation", i, ":", e$message, "\n")
          return(NULL)
        })
      } else {
        cat("  Simulation", i, "is NULL or not MizerSim\n")
        return(NULL)
      }
    })
    
    # Remove NULL entries and combine
    biomass_list <- biomass_list[!sapply(biomass_list, is.null)]
    cat("Valid biomass extractions:", length(biomass_list), "\n")
    
    if (length(biomass_list) > 0) {
      combined_data <- do.call(rbind, biomass_list)
      cat("Combined biomass data rows:", nrow(combined_data), "\n")
      return(combined_data)
    } else {
      cat("No valid biomass data extracted\n")
      return(data.frame())
    }
  }
  
  # Function to extract and combine yield data from multiple simulations
  extract_monte_carlo_yield <- function(sim_list, sim_names = NULL) {
    cat("Extracting yield from", length(sim_list), "simulations...\n")
    
    if (is.null(sim_names)) {
      sim_names <- paste0("MC_", seq_along(sim_list))
    }
    
    yield_list <- lapply(seq_along(sim_list), function(i) {
      sim <- sim_list[[i]]
      cat("Processing simulation", i, "for yield - Class:", class(sim), "\n")
      
      if (!is.null(sim) && inherits(sim, "MizerSim")) {
        tryCatch({
          yield_matrix <- getYield(sim)
          cat("  Yield matrix dimensions:", dim(yield_matrix), "\n")
          
          yield_df <- reshape2::melt(yield_matrix)
          names(yield_df) <- c("Year", "Species", "Yield")
          yield_df$Simulation <- sim_names[i]
          
          cat("  Extracted yield data rows:", nrow(yield_df), "\n")
          return(yield_df)
        }, error = function(e) {
          cat("  Error extracting yield from simulation", i, ":", e$message, "\n")
          return(NULL)
        })
      } else {
        cat("  Simulation", i, "is NULL or not MizerSim\n")
        return(NULL)
      }
    })
    
    # Remove NULL entries and combine
    yield_list <- yield_list[!sapply(yield_list, is.null)]
    cat("Valid yield extractions:", length(yield_list), "\n")
    
    if (length(yield_list) > 0) {
      combined_data <- do.call(rbind, yield_list)
      cat("Combined yield data rows:", nrow(combined_data), "\n")
      return(combined_data)
    } else {
      cat("No valid yield data extracted\n")
      return(data.frame())
    }
  }
  
  # Extract biomass data from accepted simulations
  cat("Debugging biomass extraction...\n")
  cat("Number of accepted simulations:", length(rejection_results$accepted_simulations), "\n")
  
  # Debug: Check structure of first accepted simulation
  if (length(rejection_results$accepted_simulations) > 0) {
    first_sim <- rejection_results$accepted_simulations[[1]]
    cat("First simulation class:", class(first_sim), "\n")
    cat("First simulation is MizerSim?", inherits(first_sim, "MizerSim"), "\n")
    if (inherits(first_sim, "MizerSim")) {
      cat("First simulation dimensions:", dim(getBiomass(first_sim)), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  mc_biomass_data <- extract_monte_carlo_biomass(rejection_results$accepted_simulations)
  cat("Extracted biomass data rows:", nrow(mc_biomass_data), "\n")
  
  if (nrow(mc_biomass_data) > 0) {
    cat("Sample of biomass data:\n")
    print(head(mc_biomass_data))
    cat("Species in biomass data:", unique(mc_biomass_data$Species), "\n")
    cat("Year range in biomass data:", range(mc_biomass_data$Year), "\n")
    # Calculate uncertainty bounds for biomass
    cat("Calculating biomass uncertainty bounds...\n")
    biomass_uncertainty <- mc_biomass_data %>%
      group_by(Year, Species) %>%
      summarise(
        median = median(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
        q05 = quantile(Biomass, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
        q25 = quantile(Biomass, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        q75 = quantile(Biomass, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        q95 = quantile(Biomass, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean = mean(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_sims = n(),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ) %>%
      mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order))
    
    cat("Biomass uncertainty summary:\n")
    cat("Number of Year-Species combinations:", nrow(biomass_uncertainty), "\n")
    cat("Number of simulations per combination:", unique(biomass_uncertainty$n_sims), "\n")
    if (nrow(biomass_uncertainty) > 0) {
      cat("Sample uncertainty values:\n")
      print(head(biomass_uncertainty))
    }
    
    # Create observation data for plotting
    # Join species-specific bounds and expand across plotting years
    bounds_df <- obs_biomass_bounds %>% select(Species, Lower = Lower_g, Upper = Upper_g, RangeSource)
    obs_biomass_ts <- obs_biomass_data %>%
      left_join(bounds_df, by = "Species") %>%
  tidyr::crossing(Year = 2000:2010) %>%
      mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order))
    
  # Monte Carlo biomass plot with uncertainty ribbons
    cat("Creating biomass plot...\n")
    p_biomass_mc <- ggplot()
    
    # Only add ribbons if we have multiple simulations (otherwise q05=q95=median)
  if (max(biomass_uncertainty$n_sims) > 1) {
      p_biomass_mc <- p_biomass_mc +
        # Add uncertainty ribbons (90% and 50% intervals)
    geom_ribbon(data = biomass_uncertainty, 
          aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q05, ymax = .data$q95, fill = .data$Species), 
          alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_ribbon(data = biomass_uncertainty, 
          aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q25, ymax = .data$q75, fill = .data$Species), 
          alpha = 0.3)
    }
    
    # Always add the line (median or single simulation value)
    p_biomass_mc <- p_biomass_mc +
    geom_line(data = biomass_uncertainty, 
        aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$median, color = .data$Species), 
                linewidth = 1.2) +
      # Add observed data points and uncertainty
      geom_point(data = obs_biomass_ts, 
         aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$ObsBiomass, color = .data$Species), 
                 size = 1.2, shape = 16) +
      geom_point(data = obs_biomass_ts, 
         aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$ObsBiomass), 
                 shape = 1, size = 1.2, colour = "black") +
  geom_ribbon(data = obs_biomass_ts, 
    aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$Lower, ymax = .data$Upper), 
      alpha = 0.2, fill = "gray50") +
      # Styling
    facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) scales::number(x/1e6)) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Biomass [t]", 
       title = paste("Monte Carlo: Biomass vs Observations (", length(rejection_results$accepted_simulations), " sims)"),
           subtitle = paste("Based on", rejection_results$n_accepted, "accepted simulations (dark = 50% CI, light = 90% CI)")) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(1961, 2010), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5)
    
    print(p_biomass_mc)
    
    # Save plot
    # ggsave("monte_carlo_biomass_uncertainty_post_v009.png", p_biomass_mc, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
  }
  
  # Extract yield data from accepted simulations
  cat("Debugging yield extraction...\n")
  mc_yield_data <- extract_monte_carlo_yield(rejection_results$accepted_simulations)
  cat("Extracted yield data rows:", nrow(mc_yield_data), "\n")
  
  if (nrow(mc_yield_data) > 0) {
    cat("Sample of yield data:\n")
    print(head(mc_yield_data))
    cat("Species in yield data:", unique(mc_yield_data$Species), "\n")
    cat("Year range in yield data:", range(mc_yield_data$Year), "\n")
  }
  
  if (nrow(mc_yield_data) > 0 && exists("yield_ts_tidy")) {
    cat("Calculating yield uncertainty bounds (baseline style)...\n")
    # Prepare combined MC yield and compute uncertainty
    mc_yield <- mc_yield_data %>% mutate(Yield = pmax(Yield, 0))
    species_with_yield <- mc_yield %>% group_by(Species) %>% summarise(max_yield = max(Yield, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>% filter(max_yield > 0) %>% pull(Species)
    cat("Accepted sims: species with fishing yields:", paste(species_with_yield, collapse = ", "), "\n")

    yield_uncertainty <- mc_yield %>%
      filter(Species %in% species_with_yield) %>%
      group_by(Year, Species) %>%
      summarise(
        median = median(Yield, na.rm = TRUE),
        q25 = quantile(Yield, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        q75 = quantile(Yield, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        q05 = quantile(Yield, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
        q95 = quantile(Yield, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ) %>%
      mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order))

    # Observed positive-yield presence by year/species
    obs_pos_by_year <- yield_ts_tidy %>%
      mutate(has_obs_pos = Yield > 0) %>%
      group_by(Year, Species) %>%
      summarise(has_obs_pos = any(has_obs_pos, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

    # Filter modeled zeros only in years without observed positive yield
    yield_uncertainty <- yield_uncertainty %>%
      left_join(obs_pos_by_year, by = c("Year", "Species")) %>%
      mutate(has_obs_pos = coalesce(has_obs_pos, FALSE))

    yield_uncertainty_ribbon <- yield_uncertainty %>%
      filter(!(has_obs_pos == FALSE & (is.na(q95) | q95 <= 0))) %>%
      mutate(
        q05 = ifelse(q05 > 0, q05, NA_real_),
        q25 = ifelse(q25 > 0, q25, NA_real_),
        q75 = ifelse(q75 > 0, q75, NA_real_),
        q95 = ifelse(q95 > 0, q95, NA_real_)
      ) %>%
      filter(!(is.na(q25) & is.na(q75) & is.na(q05) & is.na(q95)))

    yield_uncertainty_line <- yield_uncertainty %>%
      filter(!(has_obs_pos == FALSE & (is.na(median) | median <= 0))) %>%
      mutate(median = ifelse(median > 0, median, NA_real_))

    # Observed yields filtered to species with modeled yields
    yield_obs_filtered <- yield_ts_tidy %>%
      filter(Species %in% species_with_yield, Yield > 0) %>%
      mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order))

    # Determine plotting x-range
    baleen_start_obs <- yield_obs_filtered %>%
      filter(Species == "baleen whales") %>%
      summarise(min_year = min(Year, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      pull(min_year)
    global_start_obs <- yield_obs_filtered %>% summarise(min_year = min(Year, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% pull(min_year)
    start_year <- if (!is.null(baleen_start_obs) && length(baleen_start_obs) == 1 && is.finite(baleen_start_obs)) {
      baleen_start_obs
    } else if (!is.null(global_start_obs) && length(global_start_obs) == 1 && is.finite(global_start_obs)) {
      global_start_obs
    } else { 1930 }
    end_year <- max(yield_uncertainty$Year, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Custom label: no decimals for >=1; dynamic decimals for <1 so first non-zero digit shows
    label_dynamic_decimals <- function(x) {
      sci <- scales::label_scientific(digits = 1)
      vapply(x, function(v) {
        if (is.na(v)) return(NA_character_)
        if (v <= 0) return("0")
        vt <- v / 1e6  # convert grams -> tonnes
        if (vt >= 1) {
          paste0(formatC(vt, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","), " t")
        } else if (vt < 1e-6) {
          paste0(sci(vt), " t")
        } else {
          dp <- max(1, ceiling(-log10(vt)))
          dp <- min(dp, 6)
          paste0(formatC(vt, format = "f", digits = dp), " t")
        }
      }, character(1))
    }

    # Plot in baseline style (log10 y, ribbons, observed overlays)
    p_yield_mc <- ggplot() +
      geom_ribbon(data = yield_uncertainty_ribbon, aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q05, ymax = .data$q95, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_ribbon(data = yield_uncertainty_ribbon, aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q25, ymax = .data$q75, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.3) +
      geom_line(data = yield_uncertainty_line, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$median, color = .data$Species), linewidth = 1.0, linetype = "solid", lineend = "round") +
      geom_point(data = yield_obs_filtered, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$Yield, colour = .data$Species), size = 1) +
      geom_point(data = yield_obs_filtered, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$Yield), shape = 1, size = 1, colour = "black") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 1961, linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 2010, linetype = "dashed") +
      scale_y_log10(breaks = scales::log_breaks(n = 6), labels = label_dynamic_decimals) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(start_year, end_year)) +
      facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
      labs(x = "Year", y = "Yield [t/year]", title = paste("Monte Carlo: Yield vs Observations (", length(rejection_results$accepted_simulations), " sims)"))

    print(p_yield_mc)

     #ggsave("yield_uncertainty_post_monte_carlo_results_nsims_3000_SD_2_4_3_tol_0.0025_tmax_1500.png", p_yield_mc, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300) 
  }
  
  # Summary statistics for uncertainty assessment
  if (nrow(mc_biomass_data) > 0) {
    cat("\n=== UNCERTAINTY SUMMARY ===\n")
    
    # Calculate uncertainty metrics for the final period (2005-2010)
    final_period_biomass <- mc_biomass_data %>%
      filter(Year >= 2005, Year <= 2010) %>%
      group_by(Species) %>%
      summarise(
        median_biomass = median(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
        cv = sd(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
        min_biomass = min(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
        max_biomass = max(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
        uncertainty_range = max(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE) / min(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = 'drop'
      )
    
    cat("Biomass uncertainty summary (2005-2010):\n")
    print(final_period_biomass %>% 
          arrange(desc(cv)) %>%
          mutate(cv = round(cv, 3), uncertainty_range = round(uncertainty_range, 2)))
    
    cat("\nSpecies with highest uncertainty (CV > 0.5):\n")
    high_uncertainty <- final_period_biomass %>% 
      filter(cv > 0.5) %>% 
      arrange(desc(cv))
    if (nrow(high_uncertainty) > 0) {
      print(high_uncertainty)
    } else {
      cat("No species with CV > 0.5\n")
    }
  }
  
} else {
  cat("No accepted simulations available for Monte Carlo assessment.\n")
}
```

## Step 5: Compare Modeled vs Observed (Accepted Simulations Only)

Finally, let's compare the biomass and yield from our accepted simulations with observations.

```{r compare-accepted-simulations}
if (rejection_results$n_accepted > 0) {
  cat("=== COMPARING ACCEPTED SIMULATIONS WITH OBSERVATIONS ===\n")
  
  # Extract yield and biomass data from accepted simulations
  accepted_yield_data <- extract_simulation_data(rejection_results$accepted_simulations, "yield")
  accepted_biomass_data <- extract_simulation_data(rejection_results$accepted_simulations, "biomass")
  
  # Function to calculate uncertainty bounds
  calculate_uncertainty_bounds <- function(data, group_cols, value_col) {
    data %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(group_cols))) %>%
      summarise(
        mean = mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        median = median(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        q25 = quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        q75 = quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        q05 = quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
        q95 = quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
        min = min(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        max = max(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = 'drop'
      )
  }
  
  # Calculate yield uncertainty bounds
  yield_bounds <- calculate_uncertainty_bounds(accepted_yield_data, c("Year", "Species"), "Yield")
  
  # Calculate biomass uncertainty bounds  
  biomass_bounds <- calculate_uncertainty_bounds(accepted_biomass_data, c("Year", "Species"), "Biomass")
  
  # Plot yield comparison with uncertainty bounds
  p_yield_accepted <- ggplot() +
    # Add uncertainty ribbons
    geom_ribbon(data = yield_bounds, 
                aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q05, ymax = .data$q95, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_ribbon(data = yield_bounds, 
                aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q25, ymax = .data$q75, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.4) +
    # Add median line
    geom_line(data = yield_bounds, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$median, color = .data$Species), linewidth = 1) +
    # Add observed data points
    geom_point(data = yield_ts_tidy, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$Yield, color = .data$Species), size = 1.5) +
    geom_point(data = yield_ts_tidy, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$Yield), shape = 1, size = 1.5, colour = "black") +
    # Styling
    facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
    labs(
      title = "Accepted Simulations: Yield vs Observations",
      subtitle = paste("n =", rejection_results$n_accepted, "simulations passing biomass criteria"),
      x = "Year", y = "Yield"
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(1961, 2010), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5)
  
  print(p_yield_accepted)
  
  # Plot biomass comparison with uncertainty bounds
  p_biomass_accepted <- ggplot() +
    # Add uncertainty ribbons
    geom_ribbon(data = biomass_bounds, 
                aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q05, ymax = .data$q95, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_ribbon(data = biomass_bounds, 
                aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q25, ymax = .data$q75, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.4) +
    # Add median line
    geom_line(data = biomass_bounds, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$median, color = .data$Species), linewidth = 1) +
    # Add observed data (2010-2020 period)
  geom_point(data = obs_biomass_data %>% left_join(obs_biomass_bounds %>% select(Species, Lower = Lower_g, Upper = Upper_g), by = "Species") %>% tidyr::crossing(Year = 2005:2010), 
         aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$ObsBiomass, color = .data$Species), size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = obs_biomass_data %>% left_join(obs_biomass_bounds %>% select(Species, Lower = Lower_g, Upper = Upper_g), by = "Species") %>% tidyr::crossing(Year = 2005:2010), 
         aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$ObsBiomass), shape = 1, size = 1.5, colour = "black") +
    # Styling
    facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
    labs(
      title = "Accepted Simulations: Biomass vs Observations", 
      subtitle = paste("n =", rejection_results$n_accepted, "simulations passing biomass criteria"),
      x = "Year", y = "Biomass"
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(1961, 2010), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5)
  
  print(p_biomass_accepted)
  
  # Save results for future use (commented out for testing)
  # saveRDS(rejection_results, "biomass_filtered_uncertainty_results.RDS")
  cat("\n(Results not saved during testing - uncomment saveRDS line for production)\n")
  
} else {
  cat("Cannot create comparison plots - no simulations passed rejection criteria.\n")
  cat("Consider:\n")
  cat("1. Increasing tolerance (currently 25%)\n") 
  cat("2. Relaxing rejection criteria (allow some species to be outside bounds)\n")
  cat("3. Increasing number of simulations\n")
}

# Combine successful simulations and metadata across saved Monte Carlo result files
combine_successful_sims <- function(
  search_dirs = c("Output_large_files", "."),
  pattern = "^monte_carlo_results.*\\.rds$",
  out_rds = file.path("Output_large_files", paste0("combined_successful_sims_", format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"), ".rds")),
  out_csv = file.path("Output_large_files", paste0("combined_successful_params_summary_", format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"), ".csv")),
  verbose = TRUE
) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(dplyr)
    library(tibble)
  })
  # Helper for NULL-coalesce
  `%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

  # Discover files
  files <- unique(unlist(lapply(search_dirs, function(d) {
    if (dir.exists(d)) list.files(d, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE) else character(0)
  })))
  if (length(files) == 0) stop("No Monte Carlo results files found.")
  if (verbose) cat("Found", length(files), "result files\n")

  # Containers
  all_sims <- list()
  all_params <- list()
  sim_keys <- character()

  make_run_id <- function(obj, fname) {
    if (!is.null(obj$settings) && is.list(obj$settings)) {
      s <- obj$settings
      paste0(
        "nsims=", s$total_sims %||% NA,
        ";sd=", s$catchability_sd %||% NA, "_", s$abundance_sd %||% NA, "_", s$gamma_sd %||% NA,
        ";tol=", s$enhanced_steady_tol %||% NA, ";tmax=", s$enhanced_steady_t_max %||% NA
      )
    } else {
      basename(fname)
    }
  }

  # Read and collect
  for (f in files) {
    obj <- try(readRDS(f), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(obj, "try-error")) { if (verbose) cat("Skipping unreadable:", f, "\n"); next }
    if (!is.list(obj) || is.null(obj$simulations) || is.null(obj$parameters)) {
      if (verbose) cat("Skipping non-results object:", f, "\n")
      next
    }
    sims <- obj$simulations
    params <- obj$parameters
    if (!length(sims) || !length(params)) next

    run_id <- make_run_id(obj, f)

    for (i in seq_along(sims)) {
      s <- sims[[i]]; p <- params[[i]]
      if (is.null(s) || is.null(p)) next
      key <- paste0(run_id, "::", (p$sim_id %||% i))
      all_sims[[length(all_sims)+1L]] <- s
      all_params[[length(all_params)+1L]] <- c(p, list(run_id = run_id, source_file = f, sim_key = key))
      sim_keys[length(sim_keys)+1L] <- key
    }
  }

  # Build parameter tibble (list-columns for vectors)
  param_tbl <- tibble(
    sim_key = sim_keys,
    run_id = sapply(all_params, `[[`, "run_id"),
    source_file = sapply(all_params, `[[`, "source_file"),
    sim_id_within_file = sapply(all_params, function(x) x$sim_id %||% NA_integer_),
    stable = sapply(all_params, function(x) x$stable %||% NA),
    max_cv = sapply(all_params, function(x) x$max_cv %||% NA_real_),
    species_names = lapply(all_params, `[[`, "species_names"),
    abundance_scaling = lapply(all_params, `[[`, "abundance_scaling"),
    gamma_change = lapply(all_params, function(x) x$gamma_change %||% x$gamma_change_raw %||% NA),
    catchability = lapply(all_params, `[[`, "catchability"),
    catchability_change = lapply(all_params, `[[`, "catchability_change")
  )

  # Flat summary CSV (no heavy list columns)
  flat_summary <- param_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      sim_key, run_id, source_file, sim_id_within_file, stable, max_cv,
      n_species = vapply(species_names, length, integer(1)),
      mean_gamma_mult = vapply(gamma_change, function(v) if (is.null(v)) NA_real_ else mean(as.numeric(v), na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1)),
      mean_abund_mult = vapply(abundance_scaling, function(v) if (is.null(v)) NA_real_ else mean(as.numeric(v), na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1)),
      mean_catchability = vapply(catchability, function(v) if (is.null(v)) NA_real_ else mean(as.numeric(v), na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))
    )

  # Save combined artifact
  combined <- list(
    simulations = all_sims,
    parameters = param_tbl,
    created = Sys.time()
  )
  dir.create(dirname(out_rds), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  saveRDS(combined, out_rds)
  utils::write.csv(flat_summary, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)

  if (verbose) cat("Saved combined successful sims:\n - RDS:", out_rds, "\n - CSV:", out_csv, "\nTotal successes:", length(all_sims), "\n")
  invisible(combined)
}

# Run it
combined_success <- combine_successful_sims()

# Analysis Complete

This restructured analysis provides:

1. **Core Functions Integration**: All critical uncertainty analysis functions moved from Helper_Functions.R
2. **Parameter Distribution Assessment**: Comprehensive plotting and statistics for Monte Carlo parameters  
3. **Biomass Rejection Criteria**: Strict filtering based on 2000-2010 modeled vs 2010-2020 observed biomass (±25% tolerance)
4. **Post-Rejection Analysis**: Comparison of parameter distributions and model performance after filtering
5. **Uncertainty Quantification**: Full uncertainty bounds for accepted simulations

The analysis is now self-contained and transparent, with clear assessment of parameter space coverage and model performance relative to observations.
        }
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
        cat("Sim", sim_id, "steady-state failed:", e$message, "\nTrying again with parameter adjustment\n")
      }
      # Small parameter adjustment on error too
      if (attempt < max_attempts) {
        sp_params <- species_params(params)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sp_params))) {
          if (runif(1) < 0.2) {  # 20% chance to adjust each species
            adjustment <- runif(1, 0.98, 1.02)  # ±2% adjustment
            params@initial_n[i,] <- params@initial_n[i,] * adjustment
          }
        }
      }
    })
    
    attempt <- attempt + 1
  }
  
  # If all attempts failed, return original params with warning
  if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
    cat("Sim", sim_id, "steady-state failed after", max_attempts, "attempts. Using original parameters.\n")
  }
  return(list(params = params, steady_failed = TRUE))
}

# Enhanced spin-up function with multiple cycles and stability checks
enhanced_spinup <- function(params,
                           spinup_years = 118,
                           spinup_multiplier = 1,    # Can be 2, 3, or 4 for extended spinup
                           effort_scenario,
                           stability_tolerance = stability_cv_threshold,  # default from global settings
                           t_start = 1841,
                           final_years = 170,
                           verbose = FALSE,
                           sim_id = NULL) {
  
  total_spinup_years <- spinup_years * spinup_multiplier
  if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
    cat("Sim", sim_id, "running enhanced spinup for", total_spinup_years, "years (", 
        spinup_multiplier, "x base period)\n")
  }
  
  # Step 1: Initial spinup without fishing
  sim_spinup <- project(params, 
                       t_start = t_start, 
                       t_max = total_spinup_years,
                       effort = 0)
  
  # Step 2: Check biomass stability during spinup (NO FISHING PERIOD)
  # This is the key fix - we check stability on the spinup simulation, not the final one
  spinup_stability_check <- check_biomass_stability_enhanced(
    sim_spinup,
    tolerance = stability_tolerance,
    check_years = min(stability_check_years_tail, total_spinup_years),
    trend_first_years = stability_trend_first_years,
    trend_rel_slope_max = stability_trend_rel_slope_max,
    trend_pval = stability_trend_pval_max,
    min_mean_biomass = stability_min_mean_biomass,
    verbose = verbose,
    sim_id = sim_id
  )
  
  # Handle both return formats
  if (is.list(spinup_stability_check)) {
    is_stable <- spinup_stability_check$stable
  } else {
    is_stable <- spinup_stability_check
  }
  
  if (!is_stable) {
    if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
      cat("Sim", sim_id, "spinup not stable, extending by 50%\n")
    }
    # Extend spinup if not stable
    extended_spinup <- project(params,
                              initial_n = sim_spinup@n[total_spinup_years,,],
                              t_start = t_start + total_spinup_years,
                              t_max = round(total_spinup_years * 0.5),
                              effort = 0)
    
    # Check stability of extended spinup
    extended_stability_check <- check_biomass_stability_enhanced(
      extended_spinup,
      tolerance = stability_tolerance,
      check_years = min(30, round(total_spinup_years * 0.5)),
      trend_first_years = stability_trend_first_years,
      trend_rel_slope_max = stability_trend_rel_slope_max,
      trend_pval = stability_trend_pval_max,
      min_mean_biomass = stability_min_mean_biomass,
      verbose = verbose,
      sim_id = sim_id
    )
    
    if (is.list(extended_stability_check)) {
      is_stable <- extended_stability_check$stable
    } else {
      is_stable <- extended_stability_check
    }
    
    final_initial_n <- extended_spinup@n[round(total_spinup_years * 0.5),,]
  } else {
    if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
      cat("Sim", sim_id, "spinup achieved stability\n")
    }
    final_initial_n <- sim_spinup@n[total_spinup_years,,]
  }
  
  # Step 3: Run main simulation with fishing effort
  # This simulation will have variability due to fishing - that's expected and normal!
  sim_final <- project(params,
                      initial_n = final_initial_n,
                      t_start = t_start,
                      t_max = final_years,
                      effort = effort_scenario)
  
  return(list(
    simulation = sim_final,
    spinup_stable = is_stable,
    final_initial_n = final_initial_n,
    spinup_simulation = sim_spinup  # Return spinup sim for diagnostics if needed
  ))
}

# Enhanced model performance evaluation with multiple metrics
calculate_enhanced_performance_metrics <- function(sim_object,
                                                  yield_obs_data,
                                                  species_weights_df = species_weights,
                                                  species_list = NULL,
                                                  year_range = NULL) {
  
  # Get modeled yield 
  mod_yield <- getYield(sim_object)
  df_mod <- reshape2::melt(mod_yield)
  names(df_mod) <- c("Year", "Species", "Yield")
  
  # Filter by year range and species if specified
  if (!is.null(year_range)) {
    df_mod <- df_mod[df_mod$Year >= min(year_range) & df_mod$Year <= max(year_range), ]
    yield_obs_data <- yield_obs_data[yield_obs_data$Year >= min(year_range) &
                                     yield_obs_data$Year <= max(year_range), ]
  }
  
  if (!is.null(species_list)) {
    df_mod <- df_mod[df_mod$Species %in% species_list, ]
    yield_obs_data <- yield_obs_data[yield_obs_data$Species %in% species_list, ]
  }
  
  # Merge modeled and observed data
  comparison <- merge(df_mod, yield_obs_data,
                     by = c("Year", "Species"),
                     suffixes = c("_mod", "_obs"))
  
  # Calculate comprehensive metrics by species
  metrics_by_species <- comparison %>%
    group_by(Species) %>%
    summarise(
      RMSE = sqrt(mean((Yield_mod - Yield_obs)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      MAE = mean(abs(Yield_mod - Yield_obs), na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Obs = mean(Yield_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Mod = mean(Yield_mod, na.rm = TRUE),
      Bias = mean(Yield_mod - Yield_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
      Relative_Error = sqrt(mean((Yield_mod - Yield_obs)^2, na.rm = TRUE)) / mean(Yield_obs, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      Correlation = cor(Yield_mod, Yield_obs, use = "complete.obs"),
      MAPE = mean(abs((Yield_mod - Yield_obs) / Yield_obs), na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      n_obs = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Apply species weights and calculate weighted metrics
  metrics_weighted <- metrics_by_species %>%
    left_join(species_weights_df, by = "Species") %>%
    mutate(weight = ifelse(is.na(weight), 1, weight)) # Default weight of 1 for unspecified species
  
  # Calculate weighted overall metrics
  total_weighted_rmse <- weighted.mean(metrics_weighted$RMSE, 
                                       metrics_weighted$weight * metrics_weighted$n_obs, 
                                       na.rm = TRUE)
  
  total_weighted_mae <- weighted.mean(metrics_weighted$MAE,
                                      metrics_weighted$weight * metrics_weighted$n_obs,
                                      na.rm = TRUE)
  
  total_weighted_bias <- weighted.mean(metrics_weighted$Bias,
                                       metrics_weighted$weight * metrics_weighted$n_obs,
                                       na.rm = TRUE)
  
  avg_correlation <- mean(metrics_weighted$Correlation, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # ============================================================================
  # 🎯 COMPOSITE SCORE CALCULATION (MAIN EVALUATION POINT)
  # ============================================================================
  # Option 1: Current weighted approach (emphasizes RMSE)
  # Calculate composite score (lower is better)
  # Combines multiple metrics with emphasis on RMSE
  composite_score_weighted <- (total_weighted_rmse * 0.4) +     # 40% weight: How far off predictions are (Root Mean Square Error)
                             (total_weighted_mae * 0.3) +       # 30% weight: Average absolute difference (Mean Absolute Error)  
                             (abs(total_weighted_bias) * 0.2) + # 20% weight: Systematic over/under-prediction (Bias)
                             ((1 - avg_correlation) * 0.1)      # 10% weight: How well patterns match (1 minus Correlation)
  
  # Option 2: Equal weighting approach (balanced contribution)
  composite_score_equal <- (total_weighted_rmse * 0.25) +       # 25% weight: How far off predictions are
                          (total_weighted_mae * 0.25) +         # 25% weight: Average absolute difference
                          (abs(total_weighted_bias) * 0.25) +   # 25% weight: Systematic over/under-prediction
                          ((1 - avg_correlation) * 0.25)        # 25% weight: How well patterns match
  
  # Default to weighted approach for backward compatibility
  composite_score <- composite_score_weighted
  # ============================================================================
  
  return(list(
    total_weighted_rmse = total_weighted_rmse,
    total_weighted_mae = total_weighted_mae,
    total_weighted_bias = total_weighted_bias,
    avg_correlation = avg_correlation,
    composite_score = composite_score,
    composite_score_weighted = composite_score_weighted,
    composite_score_equal = composite_score_equal,
    metrics_by_species = metrics_by_species,
    metrics_weighted = metrics_weighted,
    comparison_data = comparison
  ))
}

# Function to run a single simulation with enhanced protocols and diagnostics
run_enhanced_single_sim <- function(sim_id, params, catchability_sd, abundance_sd, gamma_sd,
                                   all_species_abundance, marine_mammal_species, effort_scen, 
                                   enhanced_steady_tol, enhanced_steady_t_max,
                                   spinup_years, spinup_multiplier,
                                   t_start, sim_years,
                                   preserve_erepro, max_erepro,
                                   species_weights_df,
                                   yield_obs_data,
                                   verbose = FALSE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("=== Starting enhanced simulation", sim_id, "===\n")
  }
  
  # Create copy of params
  rand_params <- params
  
  # Step 1: Randomize catchability for fished species
  gear_df <- gear_params(rand_params)
  original_catchability <- gear_df$catchability
  
  if(nrow(gear_df) > 0) {
    for(j in 1:nrow(gear_df)) {
      if(gear_df$catchability[j] > 0) {
        noise <- rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = catchability_sd)
        gear_df$catchability[j] <- gear_df$catchability[j] * exp(noise)
        gear_df$catchability[j] <- min(1, max(0, gear_df$catchability[j]))
      }
    }
    # Safety: clamp all catchability values to [0,1] post-randomization
    gear_df$catchability <- pmin(1, pmax(0, gear_df$catchability))
    gear_params(rand_params) <- gear_df
  }
  
  # Step 2: Randomize gamma (search rate) for all species
  sp_params <- species_params(rand_params)
  original_gamma <- sp_params$gamma
  
  # Apply gamma variation to all species
  for(j in 1:nrow(sp_params)) {
    gamma_noise <- rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = gamma_sd)
    sp_params$gamma[j] <- sp_params$gamma[j] * exp(gamma_noise)
    # Ensure gamma stays within reasonable bounds (e.g., 0.01 to 1000)
    sp_params$gamma[j] <- min(1000, max(0.01, sp_params$gamma[j]))
  }
  
  species_params(rand_params) <- sp_params
  
  # Step 3: Randomize initial abundance
  if (all_species_abundance) {
    # NEW: Vary abundance for ALL species, not just marine mammals
    all_species <- sp_params$species
    scaling_factors <- exp(rnorm(length(all_species), mean = 0, sd = abundance_sd))
    
    for (k in seq_along(all_species)) {
      rand_params@initial_n[k,] <- rand_params@initial_n[k,] * scaling_factors[k]
    }
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("Sim", sim_id, "parameter modifications:\n")
      cat("  - Catchability changes: ", paste(round(gear_df$catchability / original_catchability, 2), collapse = ", "), "\n")
      cat("  - Gamma changes: ", paste(round(sp_params$gamma / original_gamma, 2), collapse = ", "), "\n")
      cat("  - All species abundance scaling: ", paste(round(scaling_factors, 2), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    }
    
    # Store marine mammal scaling for tracking
    marine_mammal_indices <- which(sp_params$species %in% marine_mammal_species)
    marine_mammal_scaling <- scaling_factors[marine_mammal_indices]
    
  } else {
    # Original behavior: Only marine mammals
    species_indices <- which(sp_params$species %in% marine_mammal_species)
    scaling_factors <- exp(rnorm(length(species_indices), mean = 0, sd = abundance_sd))
    
    for (k in seq_along(species_indices)) {
      rand_params@initial_n[species_indices[k],] <-
        rand_params@initial_n[species_indices[k],] * scaling_factors[k]
    }
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("Sim", sim_id, "parameter modifications:\n")
      cat("  - Catchability changes: ", paste(round(gear_df$catchability / original_catchability, 2), collapse = ", "), "\n")
      cat("  - Gamma changes: ", paste(round(sp_params$gamma / original_gamma, 2), collapse = ", "), "\n")
      cat("  - Marine mammal abundance scaling: ", paste(round(scaling_factors, 2), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    }
    
    marine_mammal_scaling <- scaling_factors
  }
  
  # Step 3: Enhanced steady state
  steady_result <- simple_steady_state(rand_params, 
                                     tol = enhanced_steady_tol,
                                     t_max = enhanced_steady_t_max,
                                     preserve_erepro = preserve_erepro)
  
  # Check if steady state failed
  if (is.list(steady_result) && !is.null(steady_result$steady_failed)) {
    return(list(
      success = FALSE,
      reason = "steady_state_failed",
      sim_id = sim_id,
      details = "Could not achieve steady state within max attempts"
    ))
  }
  
  rand_params <- steady_result
  
  # Check erepro if not preserving
  if (!preserve_erepro) {
    current_erepro <- species_params(rand_params)$erepro
    if (any(current_erepro > max_erepro, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      return(list(
        success = FALSE,
        reason = "erepro_exceeded",
        sim_id = sim_id,
        details = paste("Max erepro:", round(max(current_erepro, na.rm = TRUE), 3))
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # Step 4: Enhanced spinup and main simulation
  sim_result <- enhanced_spinup(rand_params,
                               spinup_years = spinup_years,
                               spinup_multiplier = spinup_multiplier,
                               effort_scenario = effort_scen,
                               stability_tolerance = 0.10,  # Use 10% CV threshold for spinup stability
                               t_start = t_start,
                               final_years = sim_years,
                               verbose = verbose,
                               sim_id = sim_id)
  
  # Step 5: Check if spinup achieved stability - this is the only stability check we need!
  # The final simulation with fishing is SUPPOSED to have variability
  if (!sim_result$spinup_stable) {
    return(list(
      success = FALSE,
      reason = "spinup_instability",
      sim_id = sim_id,
      details = "Spinup period did not achieve biomass stability (>10% CV)"
    ))
  }
  
  if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
    cat("Sim", sim_id, "spinup was stable, simulation completed successfully\n")
  }
  
  # Step 6: Calculate enhanced performance metrics
  performance <- calculate_enhanced_performance_metrics(sim_result$simulation,
                                                       yield_obs_data,
                                                       species_weights_df)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Sim", sim_id, "completed successfully. Composite score:", 
        round(performance$composite_score, 4), "\n")
  }
  
  return(list(
    success = TRUE,
    sim_id = sim_id,
    simulation = sim_result$simulation,
    performance = performance,
    spinup_stable = sim_result$spinup_stable,
    params_info = list(
      sim_id = sim_id,
      species_names = sp_params$species,                            # ADD: Species names for plotting
      catchability = gear_df$catchability,
      catchability_change = gear_df$catchability / original_catchability,
      gamma_values = sp_params$gamma,                               # NEW: Store gamma values
      gamma_change = sp_params$gamma / original_gamma,              # NEW: Store gamma changes
      abundance_scaling = if(all_species_abundance) scaling_factors else marine_mammal_scaling,  # ADD: Combined abundance scaling
      marine_mammal_scaling = marine_mammal_scaling,                # Updated variable name
      all_species_scaling = if(all_species_abundance) scaling_factors else NULL,  # NEW: All species scaling if used
      marine_mammal_species = marine_mammal_species,
      all_species_abundance = all_species_abundance,                # NEW: Track which approach was used
      erepro_values = species_params(rand_params)$erepro
    )
  ))
}


# Function to find optimal parameters based on enhanced metrics
find_optimal_parameters_enhanced <- function(sim_results_list, metric = "composite_score") {
  
  # Extract performance metrics
  performance_data <- sim_results_list$performance
  
  if (length(performance_data) == 0) {
    stop("No performance data available")
  }
  
  # Debug: Show available metrics from first performance entry
  if (length(performance_data) > 0) {
    available_metrics <- names(performance_data[[1]])
    cat("Available metrics:", paste(available_metrics, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  
  # Get the specified metric values
  metric_values <- sapply(performance_data, function(x) {
    if (metric %in% names(x)) {
      return(x[[metric]])
    } else {
      return(NA)
    }
  })
  
  # Debug: Show how many valid values we found
  valid_values <- sum(!is.na(metric_values))
  cat("Found", valid_values, "valid values for metric:", metric, "\n")
  
  if (valid_values == 0) {
    stop("Could not find any valid values for metric: ", metric)
  }
  
  # Find optimal (minimum for most metrics)
  if (metric == "avg_correlation") {
    optimal_idx <- which.max(metric_values)  # Higher correlation is better
  } else {
    optimal_idx <- which.min(metric_values)  # Lower is better for RMSE, MAE, bias, composite
  }
  
  if (length(optimal_idx) == 0 || is.na(optimal_idx) || is.na(metric_values[optimal_idx])) {
    cat("Debug info:\n")
    cat("  metric_values length:", length(metric_values), "\n")
    cat("  valid values:", sum(!is.na(metric_values)), "\n")
    cat("  metric_values range:", range(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    stop("Could not find optimal simulation for metric: ", metric)
  }
  
  # Create summary statistics
  metric_stats <- data.frame(
    mean = mean(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(metric_values, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(metric_values, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  cat("\n=== OPTIMAL PARAMETER SELECTION ===\n")
  cat("Optimization metric:", metric, "\n")
  cat("Optimal simulation:", optimal_idx, "with", metric, "=", metric_values[optimal_idx], "\n")
  cat("\nMetric Statistics:\n")
  print(metric_stats)
  
  # Extract detailed performance for optimal simulation
  optimal_performance <- performance_data[[optimal_idx]]
  
  cat("\n=== OPTIMAL SIMULATION PERFORMANCE ===\n")
  cat("Weighted RMSE:", round(optimal_performance$total_weighted_rmse, 4), "\n")
  cat("Weighted MAE:", round(optimal_performance$total_weighted_mae, 4), "\n")
  cat("Weighted Bias:", round(optimal_performance$total_weighted_bias, 4), "\n")
  cat("Average Correlation:", round(optimal_performance$avg_correlation, 4), "\n")
  cat("Composite Score:", round(optimal_performance$composite_score, 4), "\n")
  
  cat("\nSpecies-specific performance:\n")
  print(optimal_performance$metrics_by_species)
  
  return(list(
    optimal_index = optimal_idx,
    optimal_metric_value = metric_values[optimal_idx],
    optimal_sim = sim_results_list$simulations[[optimal_idx]],
    optimal_params = sim_results_list$parameters[[optimal_idx]],
    optimal_performance = optimal_performance,
    all_metric_values = metric_values,
    metric_stats = metric_stats,
    metric_used = metric
  ))
}

# Function to plot RMSE distribution from uncertainty analysis
plot_rmse_distribution <- function(rmse_values,
                                  optimal_idx = NULL,
                                  plot_title = "RMSE Distribution from Combined Parameter Uncertainty") {
  
  require(ggplot2)
  
  df <- data.frame(
  Simulation = seq_along(rmse_values),
    RMSE = rmse_values
  )
  
  # Calculate statistics for annotation
  mean_rmse <- mean(rmse_values)
  median_rmse <- median(rmse_values)
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = RMSE)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      subtitle = paste("n =", length(rmse_values), "simulations"),
      x = "RMSE (Root Mean Square Error)",
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    # Add mean line
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean_rmse,
              color = "blue", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1) +
    # Add median line
    geom_vline(xintercept = median_rmse,
              color = "green", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1)
  
  # Add vertical line for optimal value if provided
  if (!is.null(optimal_idx)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_vline(xintercept = rmse_values[optimal_idx],
                color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
      annotate("text",
              x = rmse_values[optimal_idx],
              y = max(table(cut(rmse_values, 30))) * 0.9,
              label = paste("Optimal RMSE =", round(rmse_values[optimal_idx], 2)),
              hjust = -0.1, color = "red")
  }
  
  # Add legend for lines
  p <- p +
    annotate("text", x = mean_rmse, y = max(table(cut(rmse_values, 30))) * 0.8,
            label = paste("Mean =", round(mean_rmse, 2)),
            hjust = -0.1, color = "blue", size = 3) +
    annotate("text", x = median_rmse, y = max(table(cut(rmse_values, 30))) * 0.7,
            label = paste("Median =", round(median_rmse, 2)),
            hjust = -0.1, color = "green", size = 3)
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to visualize parameter combinations
plot_parameter_exploration <- function(param_combinations, rmse_values) {
  
  require(ggplot2)
  require(tidyr)
  require(dplyr)
  
  # Extract catchability and marine mammal scaling
  df_params <- data.frame(
  sim_id = seq_along(param_combinations),
    rmse = rmse_values
  )
  
  # Add catchability info (assuming single gear for simplicity)
  df_params$catchability <- sapply(param_combinations, function(x) mean(x$catchability))
  
  # Add marine mammal scaling (mean across all marine mammals)
  df_params$mammal_scaling <- sapply(param_combinations, function(x) mean(x$marine_mammal_scaling))
  
  # Create scatter plot
  p1 <- ggplot(df_params, aes(x = catchability, y = mammal_scaling, color = rmse)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", name = "RMSE") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = "Parameter Space Exploration",
      x = "Mean Catchability",
      y = "Mean Marine Mammal Scaling Factor"
    )
  
  # Create individual parameter distributions
  p2 <- ggplot(df_params, aes(x = catchability)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = "Catchability Distribution", x = "Catchability", y = "Count")
  
  p3 <- ggplot(df_params, aes(x = mammal_scaling)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = "Marine Mammal Scaling Distribution", x = "Scaling Factor", y = "Count")
  
  # Combine plots
  require(gridExtra)
  combined_plot <- grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
  
  return(combined_plot)
}
```

## Enhanced Uncertainty Analysis with Gamma and All-Species Abundance Variation

The enhanced uncertainty analysis incorporates several key improvements:

1. **Whale Species Weighting**: Marine mammals weighted 3-10x higher than fish/krill species
2. **Multiple Performance Metrics**: RMSE, MAE, bias, correlation, and composite scores
3. **Enhanced Steady-State Protocols**: Stricter tolerance (≤0.002) and longer convergence times (≥1000 years)
4. **Corrected Stability Validation**: Stability checked **only during spinup period** (no fishing), not during fished simulations
5. **Realistic CV Thresholds**: 10% CV threshold for spinup stability, allowing natural variability during fishing periods
6. **NEW: Gamma (Search Rate) Variation**: Randomizes foraging efficiency for all species using `gamma_sd` parameter
7. **NEW: All-Species Abundance Variation**: Option to vary initial abundance for all species with `all_species_abundance = TRUE`

### Key New Parameters:

- **`gamma_sd`**: Standard deviation for gamma (search rate) variation across all species
- **`all_species_abundance`**: Boolean flag to enable abundance variation for all species (default: TRUE)

The analysis now explores a much broader parameter space, including:
- Catchability uncertainty for fished species
- Gamma (foraging efficiency) uncertainty for all species  
- Initial abundance uncertainty for all species (or just marine mammals)

```

} else {

### Enhanced Uncertainty Plotting Functions

Now that we have successful enhanced simulations, we can create plots with uncertainty ribbons:

```{r enhanced-plotting-functions}
# Enhanced plotting functions with uncertainty ribbons
# Load successful enhanced simulations
if (file.exists("enhanced_simulations_for_plotting.RDS")) {
  enhanced_sims <- readRDS("enhanced_simulations_for_plotting.RDS")
  cat("Loaded", length(enhanced_sims), "successful enhanced simulations for plotting\n")
  
  # Function to calculate uncertainty ribbons from multiple simulations
  calculate_uncertainty_ribbons <- function(sim_list, metric_func, years = 1841:2010) {
    
    # Extract metric from each simulation
    metric_data <- lapply(sim_list, function(sim) {
      metric_values <- metric_func(sim)
      
      # Ensure we have the right years
      if (is.matrix(metric_values) || is.data.frame(metric_values)) {
        metric_df <- as.data.frame(metric_values)
        metric_df$year <- as.numeric(rownames(metric_df))
      } else {
        metric_df <- data.frame(
          value = metric_values,
          year = years[seq_len(length(metric_values))]
        )
      }
      
      return(metric_df)
    })
    
    # Combine all simulations and calculate quantiles
  all_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(metric_data), function(i) {
      df <- metric_data[[i]]
      df$sim_id <- i
      return(df)
    }))
    
    if (ncol(all_data) > 3) {  # Multiple species/groups
      # For multiple columns, calculate uncertainty for each
      species_cols <- names(all_data)[!names(all_data) %in% c("year", "sim_id")]
      
      uncertainty_data <- lapply(species_cols, function(species) {
        species_data <- all_data %>%
          select(year, sim_id, value = all_of(species)) %>%
          group_by(year) %>%
          summarise(
            median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            q25 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
            q75 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
            q05 = quantile(value, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            q95 = quantile(value, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = 'drop'
          ) %>%
          mutate(species = species)
        
        return(species_data)
      })
      
      return(do.call(rbind, uncertainty_data))
      
    } else {  # Single metric
      uncertainty_data <- all_data %>%
        group_by(year) %>%
        summarise(
          median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
          q25 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
          q75 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
          q05 = quantile(value, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
          q95 = quantile(value, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
          mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = 'drop'
        )
      
      return(uncertainty_data)
    }
  }
  
  # Enhanced yield plotting function with uncertainty ribbons
  plot_yield_uncertainty <- function(sim_list, observed_data = NULL, title = "Yield with Uncertainty") {
    
    # Calculate yield uncertainty ribbons
    yield_uncertainty <- calculate_uncertainty_ribbons(sim_list, getYield)
    
    # Create base plot
    p <- ggplot(yield_uncertainty, aes(x = year)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q05, ymax = q95, fill = species), alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75, fill = species), alpha = 0.4) +
      geom_line(aes(y = median, color = species), size = 1) +
      scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
      scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
      labs(
        title = title,
        x = "Year",
        y = "Yield",
        subtitle = "Ribbons show 50% (dark) and 90% (light) confidence intervals"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12)
      )
    
    # Add observed data if provided
    if (!is.null(observed_data)) {
      # Ensure column names are consistent (convert to lowercase if needed)
      obs_data_plot <- observed_data
      names(obs_data_plot) <- tolower(names(obs_data_plot))
      
      p <- p + geom_point(data = obs_data_plot, 
                         aes(x = year, y = yield, color = species), 
                         size = 2, alpha = 0.7)
    }
    
    return(p)
  }
  
  # Enhanced biomass plotting function with uncertainty ribbons
  plot_biomass_uncertainty <- function(sim_list, title = "Biomass with Uncertainty") {
    
    # Calculate biomass uncertainty ribbons
    biomass_uncertainty <- calculate_uncertainty_ribbons(sim_list, getBiomass)
    
    # Create plot
    p <- ggplot(biomass_uncertainty, aes(x = year)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q05, ymax = q95, fill = species), alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75, fill = species), alpha = 0.4) +
      geom_line(aes(y = median, color = species), size = 1) +
      scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
      scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
      scale_y_log10() +
      labs(
        title = title,
        x = "Year", 
        y = "Biomass",
        subtitle = "Ribbons show 50% (dark) and 90% (light) confidence intervals"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12)
      )
    
    return(p)
  }
  
} else {
  cat("Enhanced simulations not found. Please run the enhanced uncertainty analysis first.\n")
}
```

### Load and Analyze Enhanced Uncertainty Results

```{r load-and-analyze-results}
# Load enhanced uncertainty results if not already in environment
if (!exists("enhanced_uncertainty_results")) {
  if (file.exists("enhanced_uncertainty_final_results.RDS")) {
    cat("Loading enhanced uncertainty results from file...\n")
    enhanced_uncertainty_results <- readRDS("enhanced_uncertainty_final_results.RDS")
  } else {
    stop("Enhanced uncertainty results not found. Please run the enhanced uncertainty analysis first.")
  }
}

# Check if we have valid results
if (exists("enhanced_uncertainty_results") && length(enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance) > 0) {
  cat("Enhanced uncertainty results loaded successfully!\n")
  cat("Number of simulations:", length(enhanced_uncertainty_results$simulations), "\n")
  cat("Number of performance records:", length(enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance), "\n")
  
  # Check what metrics are available in the saved data
  available_metrics <- names(enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance[[1]])
  cat("Available metrics:", paste(available_metrics, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Calculate missing composite score variants if not present
  if (!"composite_score_weighted" %in% available_metrics) {
    cat("Adding missing composite score variants to existing data...\n")
    cat("Converting gram-scale metrics for composite scores...\n")
    
    # Add the missing metrics to each performance record
  for (i in seq_along(enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance)) {
      perf <- enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance[[i]]
      
      # Use original gram-scale metrics for composite score calculation
      rmse_grams <- perf$total_weighted_rmse
      mae_grams <- perf$total_weighted_mae
      bias_grams <- perf$total_weighted_bias
      correlation <- perf$avg_correlation
      
      # Calculate weighted composite (40-30-20-10) using original gram-scale values
      perf$composite_score_weighted <- (rmse_grams * 0.4) +
                                       (mae_grams * 0.3) +
                                       (abs(bias_grams) * 0.2) +
                                       ((1 - correlation) * 0.1)
      
      # Calculate equal composite (25-25-25-25) using original gram-scale values
      perf$composite_score_equal <- (rmse_grams * 0.25) +
                                    (mae_grams * 0.25) +
                                    (abs(bias_grams) * 0.25) +
                                    ((1 - correlation) * 0.25)
      
      # Update the performance record
      enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance[[i]] <- perf
    }
    cat("Successfully added composite score variants!\n")
  }
  
  # Find optimal parameters based on different metrics
  # 1. Composite score - WEIGHTED approach (current: 40-30-20-10)
  cat("\n=== FINDING OPTIMAL PARAMETERS (WEIGHTED COMPOSITE) ===\n")
  optimal_results_composite_weighted <- find_optimal_parameters_enhanced(
    sim_results_list = enhanced_uncertainty_results,
    metric = "composite_score_weighted"
  )
  
  # 2. Composite score - EQUAL approach (25-25-25-25)
  cat("\n=== FINDING OPTIMAL PARAMETERS (EQUAL COMPOSITE) ===\n")
  optimal_results_composite_equal <- find_optimal_parameters_enhanced(
    sim_results_list = enhanced_uncertainty_results,
    metric = "composite_score_equal"
  )
  
  # 3. Traditional composite score (default)
  cat("\n=== FINDING OPTIMAL PARAMETERS (DEFAULT COMPOSITE) ===\n")
  optimal_results_composite <- find_optimal_parameters_enhanced(
    sim_results_list = enhanced_uncertainty_results,
    metric = "composite_score"
  )
  
  # 4. Weighted RMSE only (for comparison)
  cat("\n=== FINDING OPTIMAL PARAMETERS (RMSE ONLY) ===\n")
  optimal_results_rmse <- find_optimal_parameters_enhanced(
    sim_results_list = enhanced_uncertainty_results,
    metric = "total_weighted_rmse"
  )
  
} else {
  cat("No enhanced uncertainty results available for analysis.\n")
}
